origin: Original decorative plates generated with the built-in image_gen tool for Axis Home v2. Inspected and downscaled/compressed using Chromium canvas; no external stock or user imagery. Exact generation prompts below.

today.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: decorative background plate for an Axis mobile dashboard card. Create an atmospheric editorial photograph of layered mountain ridges at sunset, dusty rose and muted coral sky, a small warm sun above the distant ridge on the upper right. Quiet hazy depth, dark wine foreground slopes. Square composition, broad calm darker lower left for live UI text to be added in code. Refined natural texture and cinematic soft light, no oversaturated colors. Full bleed image only, no app UI, no lettering, no logos, no frame, no watermark.
